Strings.String: An elusive Beach Bum is hiding somewhere in the Realm.
What is this lazy Beach Bum doing in my Realm?!
A Ghost Ship has entered the Realm.
My Ghost Ship will terrorize you pathetic peasants!
My Ghost Ship will send you to a watery grave.
You filthy mongrels stand no chance against my Ghost Ship!
My Ghost Ship's cannonballs will crush your pathetic Knights!
{KILLER}, you foul creature. I shall see to your death personally!
{KILLER}, has crossed me for the last time! My Ghost Ship shall be avenged.
{KILLER} is such a jerk!
How could a creature like {KILLER} defeat my dreaded Ghost Ship?!
The spirits of the sea will seek revenge on your worthless soul, {KILLER}!
My Ghost Ship will return!
Alas, my beautiful Ghost Ship has sunk!
Your futile efforts are no match for a Skull Shrine!
Pathetic fools! A Skull Shrine guards me!
Miserable scum! My Skull Shrine is invincible!
Insects! {COUNT} Skull Shrines still protect me
You hairless apes will never overcome my {COUNT} Skull Shrines!
You frail humans will never defeat my {COUNT} Skull Shrines!
Miserable worms like you cannot stand against my {COUNT} Skull Shrines!
Imbeciles! My {COUNT} Skull Shrines make me invincible!
{KILLER}, you insignificant cur! The penalty for destroying a Skull Shrine is death!
{KILLER}, you contemptible pig! Ruining my Skull Shrine will be the last mistake you ever make!
{KILLER}, you will rue the day you dared to defile my Skull Shrine!
{KILLER} razed one of my Skull Shrines -- I WILL HAVE MY REVENGE!
You defaced a Skull Shrine! Minions, to arms!
Your meager abilities cannot possibly challenge a Cube God!
Worthless mortals! A mighty Cube God defends me!
Wretched mongrels! An unconquerable Cube God is my bulwark!
You piteous cretins! {COUNT} Cube Gods still guard me!
Your pathetic rabble will never survive against my {COUNT} Cube Gods!
Filthy vermin! My {COUNT} Cube Gods will exterminate you!
You feeble creatures have no hope against my {COUNT} Cube Gods!
Loathsome slugs! My {COUNT} Cube Gods will defeat you!
{KILLER}, you pathetic swine! How dare you assault my Cube God?
{KILLER}, you wretched dog! You killed my Cube God!
{KILLER}, you may have destroyed my Cube God but you will never defeat me!
I have many more Cube Gods, {KILLER}!
You have dispatched my Cube God, but you will never escape my Realm!
Behold my Pentaract, and despair!
I am invincible while my Pentaract stands!
Ignorant fools! A Pentaract guards me still!
Wretched creatures! {COUNT} Pentaracts remain!
You detestable humans will never defeat my {COUNT} Pentaracts!
My {COUNT} Pentaracts will protect me forever!
Your weak efforts will never overcome my {COUNT} Pentaracts!
Defiance is useless! My {COUNT} Pentaracts will crush you!
{KILLER}, you lowly scum! You'll regret that you ever touched my Pentaract!
{KILLER}, you flea-ridden animal! You destroyed my Pentaract!
{KILLER}, by destroying my Pentaract you have sealed your own doom!
That was but one of many Pentaracts!
You have razed my Pentaract, but you will die here in my Realm!
At last, a Grand Sphinx will teach you to respect!
A Grand Sphinx is more than a match for this rabble.
Gaze upon the beauty of the Grand Sphinx and feel your last hopes drain away.
You festering rat-catchers! A Grand Sphinx will make you doubt your purpose!
My Grand Sphinxes will bewitch you with their beauty!
My {COUNT} Grand Sphinxes protect my Chamber with their lives!
Regret your choices, blasphemers! My {COUNT} Grand Sphinxes will teach you respect!
You dull-spirited apes! You shall pose no challenge for {COUNT} Grand Sphinxes!
{KILLER}, you up-jumped goat herder! You shall pay for defeating my Grand Sphinx!
{KILLER}, you foul ruffian! Do not think I forget your defiling of my Grand Sphinx!
{KILLER}, you pestiferous lout! I will not forget what you did to my Grand Sphinx!
My Grand Sphinx, she was so beautiful. I will kill you myself, {KILLER}!
My Grand Sphinx had lived for thousands of years! You, {KILLER}, will not survive the day!
The death of my Grand Sphinx shall be avenged!
Cower in fear of my Lord of the Lost Lands!
My Lord of the Lost Lands will make short work of you!
Give up now! You stand no chance against a Lord of the Lost Lands!
Pathetic fools! My Lord of the Lost Lands will crush you all!
You are nothing but disgusting slime to be scraped off the foot of my Lord of the Lost Lands!
Cower before your destroyer! You stand no chance against {COUNT} Lords of the Lost Lands!
Your pathetic band of fighters will be crushed under the might feet of my {COUNT} Lords of the Lost Lands!
Feel the awesome might of my {COUNT} Lords of the Lost Lands!
Together, my {COUNT} Lords of the Lost Lands will squash you like a bug!
Do not run! My {COUNT} Lords of the Lost Lands only wish to greet you!
You win this time, {KILLER}, but mark my words: You will fall before the day is done.
{KILLER}, I will never forget you exploited my Lord of the Lost Lands' weakness!
{KILLER}, you have done me a service! That Lord of the Lost Lands was not worthy of serving me.
You got lucky this time {KILLER}, but you stand no chance against me!
How dare you foul-mouthed hooligans treat my Lord of the Lost Lands with such indignity!
What trickery is this?! My Lord of the Lost Lands was invincible!
My Hermit God's thousand tentacles shall drag you to a watery grave!
You will be pulled to the bottom of the sea by my mighty Hermit God.
Flee from my Hermit God, unless you desire a watery grave!
My Hermit God awaits more sacrifices for the majestic Thessal.
My Hermit God will pull you beneath the waves!
You will make a tasty snack for my Hermit God!
You will make a tasty snack for my Hermit Gods!
I will enjoy watching my {COUNT} Hermit Gods fight over your corpse!
You were lucky this time, {KILLER}! You will rue this day that you killed my Hermit God!
You naive imbecile, {KILLER}! Without my Hermit God, Dreadstump is free to roam the seas without fear!
My Hermit God was more than you'll ever be, {KILLER}. I will kill you myself!
This is preposterous! There is no way you could have defeated my Hermit God!
Fools! I still have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints!
Puny mortals! My {HITPOINTS} hitpoints are more than enough!
I have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints and I shall destroy you!
Insignificant peons! I have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints!
You cosmic peasants! My {HITPOINTS} hitpoints make me mightier than you!
You have defeated my simulacrum, but I remain safe in my wine cellar!
Pathetic mortals! I have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints!
Foolish humans! My {HITPOINTS} hitpoints give me strength!
I have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints and I shall annihilate you!
Miniscule worms! I still have {HITPOINTS} hitpoints!
Galactic serfs! Cower before my {HITPOINTS} hitpoints!
You puny mortals! I....shall....return....!
My skeletons will make short work of you.
{PLAYER}, you are no match for my army of undead!
{PLAYER}, you will soon be my undead slave!
You will never leave this graveyard alive!
More bones for my collection!
My final Deathmage will kill you all!
My final Deathmage shall exterminate you!
Fools! I still have {COUNT} deathmages protecting me!
My {COUNT} deathmages will collect your bones!
How dare you disturb my eternal slumber, {PLAYER}!
I will eat your soul, {PLAYER}!
You will drown in a sea of undead!
All that I touch turns to dust!
My final Lich will protect me forever!
My final Lich shall consume your souls!
I am invincible while my {COUNT} Liches still stand!
My {COUNT} Liches will feast on your essence!
How dare you disturb our grove!
The forest shall crush you, {PLAYER}!
In this place, the trees fight back!
You chop and you burn... you deserve no mercy!
The last man-thing I crushed looked just like you, {PLAYER}!
You will find no wood for your fires here... only death!
You fell ancient trees without remorse; it ends now!
My final Ent Ancient will destroy you all!
My final Ent Ancient shall crush you!
Mortal scum! My {COUNT} Ent Ancients will defend me forever!
My forest of {COUNT} Ent Ancients is all the protection I need!
I rule this place, {PLAYER}!
Minions! We shall have {PLAYER} for dinner!
You must be thirsty, {PLAYER}. Enter my waters!
Come closer, {PLAYER}! Yes, closer!
Surrender to my aquatic army, {PLAYER}!
A powerful Oasis Giant still fights for me!
You will never defeat me while an Oasis Giant remains!
My {COUNT} Oasis Giants will feast on your flesh!
You have no hope against my {COUNT} Oasis Giants!
Purge yourself, {PLAYER}, in the heat of my flames!
Alas, {PLAYER}, you will taste death but once!
I have met many like you, {PLAYER}, in my thrice thousand years.
Some die and are ashes, but I am ever reborn!.
The ashes of past heroes cover my plains!
This place is not for mortals, {PLAYER}. Begone whence you came!
My last Phoenix Lord will blacken your bones!
My final Phoenix Lord will never fall!
Maggots! My {COUNT} Phoenix Lords will burn you to ash!
My {COUNT} Phoenix Lords will serve me forever!
I do not fear the corporeal
Do you think your weapons can hurt me, {PLAYER}?
My kingdom is long dead, but our spirits drag on.
Do not defile our memory of this place!
My kingdom was burned to ashes... you can do no worse.
There was joy here, once.
We have grown lonely over the millenia. Join us, {PLAYER}.
A mighty Ghost King remains to guard me!
My final Ghost King is untouchable!
My {COUNT} Ghost Kings give me more than enough protection!
Pathetic humans! My {COUNT} Ghost Kings shall destroy you utterly!
Leave my castle!
You will be my food, {PLAYER}!
I will suck the marrow from your bones!
More wine!
Blargh!!
I will floss with your tendons!
Die, puny human!
I smell the blood of an Englishman!
My last Cyclops God will smash you to pieces!
My final Cyclops God shall crush your puny skulls!
My {COUNT} powerful Cyclops Gods will smash you!
Cretins! I have {COUNT} Cyclops Gods to guard me!
Would you attempt to destroy us? I know your name, {PLAYER}!
Our anguish is endless, unlike your lives!
What do you know of suffering? I can teach you much, {PLAYER}
I will deliver your soul to Oryx, {PLAYER}!
There can be no forgiveness!
You cannot hurt us. You cannot help us. You will feed us.
Oryx will not end our pain. We can only share it... with you!
Your life is an affront to Oryx. You will die.
My final Red Demon is unassailable!
A Red Demon still guards me!
Fools! There is no escape from my {COUNT} Red Demons!
My legion of {COUNT} Red Demons live only to serve me!
It is a glorious thing to be a Pirate King!
Arrrrrrr!!!
More rum!
Oryx's minions will eat well tonight!
Ahhhh!! Fresh meat for the minions!
More mortals for the minions to feast on!
Plump and fleshy! Just like I like them!
Guards! Bring in another prisoner!
Oryx always feeds his minions well!
Another glorious day in Oryx's kitchens!
This one can go in the soup!
Those who damage me may find great treasure, {PLAYER}, but the gods will not forget this insult!
